one_line: 18th‑century Meitei king of Manipur who fused Lai Haraoba, martial arts and Gaudiya Vaishnavism into the Ras Lila tradition.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean but wiry, dancer’s build with strong legs and flexible posture
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, medium brown Meitei complexion, straight nose, sharp dark eyes with a calm yet intense gaze, neatly groomed moustache and short trimmed beard along the jawline, default expression serene and contemplative with a hint of resolve
appearance.hair: straight black hair gathered into a low, tight topknot at the back of the crown, smoothed and oiled; a thin white cotton headband wraps around the forehead and ties at the back, small knot and short tails visible above the topknot
appearance.costume: He wears a long-sleeved white cotton tunic (phijom-like kurta) reaching mid-thigh with a simple round neck and side slits, over snug off-white cotton churidar-style trousers gathered at the ankles; over this, a soft, handwoven cream dhoti wrapped securely around the waist and brought between the legs for ease of martial and dance movements, bordered with a narrow deep-red stripe; around his torso he has a light, pale-gold silk angavastram shawl draped from the left shoulder across the chest and tucked at the right hip, its edge subtly woven with tiny repeating leaf motifs; his waist is cinched with a broad red cotton cloth belt (khabak) wrapped multiple times and knotted at the left side, ends hanging to knee level; on his feet, simple brown leather sandals; jewellery is modest—thin gold hoops in both ears, a single tulsi bead mala around his neck, and a narrow copper bangle on his right wrist; overall the fabrics are matte, practical cottons and light silks reflecting 18th-century Vaishnava austerity blended with royal dignity.
appearance.signature: A compact, polished wooden pung (drum) slung diagonally across his torso with a sturdy brown leather strap, drum body warm brown with simple carved bands and laced rawhide, always resting against his right hip with his right hand poised as if ready to strike.

ref_desc: King Bhagya Chandra is a mid-30s lean Meitei man with oval face, brown complexion, trimmed moustache and beard, black hair in a low topknot with white headband, wearing white tunic, off-white trousers, cream dhoti, pale-gold shawl, red waist belt, simple jewellery and brown sandals, carrying a brown wooden pung drum on a leather strap.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of King Bhagya Chandra: a mid-30s lean Meitei man with a dancer’s build, oval face, medium brown complexion, sharp dark eyes, straight nose, and a neatly groomed moustache with a short trimmed beard along the jawline, his expression serene and contemplative with quiet resolve. His straight black hair is oiled smooth and gathered into a low tight topknot at the back of the crown, wrapped by a thin white cotton headband around the forehead, tied at the back with a small knot and short tails above the topknot. He wears a long-sleeved white cotton tunic reaching mid-thigh with a simple round neck and side slits, over snug off-white churidar-style trousers gathered at the ankles. Over this is a soft cream dhoti wrapped around the waist and brought between the legs for ease of movement, bordered with a narrow deep-red stripe, and a pale-gold silk angavastram shawl draped from his left shoulder across the chest and tucked at the right hip, with subtle tiny leaf motifs at the edge. His waist is bound with a broad deep-red cotton waist cloth belt wrapped several times and knotted at his left side, ends hanging to his knee, and he wears simple brown leather sandals. Add modest jewellery: thin gold hoop earrings, a single tulsi bead mala around his neck, and a narrow copper bangle on his right wrist. His signature prop is a compact polished wooden pung drum in warm brown tones with simple carved bands and visible laced rawhide, slung diagonally across his torso on a brown leather strap so it rests at his right hip, his right hand lightly poised as if about to play. Use a restrained palette of white, cream, deep red, pale gold and brown, and show front, side and back views emphasizing consistent face, hair, costume layers and the position of the drum.
